acceptanceCriteria: Use a bounded writer that cannot expose a WriteTo/ReadFrom path bypassing the byte cap; retain bounded overflow as explicit unsupported-resource-limit.
Prove io.Copy/exec copy fast paths with exact bound and overflowing stdout/stderr, preserving existing candidate output/error behavior for within-bound reads.
Retain historical packet bytes, focused independent review and native source/CEM/completion evidence or actual integration blocker.
body: Confirmed during owner-authorized P0 independent portability repair. Existing interop/cem01-go/cem.go candidateBuffer embeds bytes.Buffer; io.Copy in os/exec can select promoted ReadFrom and bypass bounded Write. Scratch Test03GitDirectChildControls output-limit emits16 bytes with limit8 and gets nil rather than unsupported-resource-limit. Original repair1-focused.log retained; verify-03 repair uses a non-embedded writer and preserves old candidate behavior pending this separate fix. Source05d66c36abf3f8c051ce12fa83670a728a98b770/treeequals163b46d. Installed Core1.0.0-rc.1build163/Tasksbuild202. This is confirmed bounded-resource capability bug, no network or hostile-helper claim.

completion.reason: Fixed in 06cf813d1fa430af0fa29d1168ab931c72d36b84 (PR beamfall/corvint#447, stacked, merged into PR #443, which merged to main as a2615609f0eb0cfae14781c14415e0e26cce2c04). candidateBuffer now holds a named bytes.Buffer, so no promoted ReadFrom/WriteString bypasses the cap; overflow sets exceeded and candidateGit returns unsupported-resource-limit. TestCandidateBufferCopyLimits covers io.Copy through both WriterTo and ReaderFrom dispatch at exact bound and overflow; TestCandidateGitDirectChildOutputLimits covers exact and overflowing stdout/stderr with and without child failure, plus within-bound repository-io. No historical protocol packet file changed (only protocol/cem-1.0/stable/ added). PR #447 records independent review PASS_WITH_FINDINGS (F1-F5 repaired, repair not re-reviewed), a sealed 62-hunk change map, and all hosted checks passing; the packet composition review is retained in the build-log entry. NOT_RUN: make gate. Evidence digests are the sha256 of each cited file at 06cf813d.

title: Portable candidate Git output bound can be bypassed through embedded Buffer.ReadFrom
